annotations.title: Send an application in the person's name

description: Send an application in the person's name. For a clear instruction about one role ("send it") once the materials have been reviewed. The first call is held: it returns a summary and a confirmation_token, and the application goes only when the same call comes back with that token after the person agrees. expected_revision is the revision they reviewed. A sent application cannot be recalled. A ready-to-read summary is in `say`.

application_id.description: Application id, from prepare_application or list_applications.

confirmation_token.description: The token from a held answer, sent with exactly the same other inputs once the person has agreed to its summary.

name: apply
